description: The line plot illustrates the relative change in performance across different layers for four distinct token-precision configurations used in KV cache compression, with the x-axis representing layer ranges (Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, Layer29-32) and the y-axis showing the relative change in percentage, ranging from -25% to 5%. The plot compares two methods—LB-Avg and RULER4k—each applied with two different token and precision settings: 2×tokens,8-bit and 1×tokens,16-bit. The yellow line with circular markers, labeled "LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit," starts at approximately 0% for Layer1-4, dips to around -3% at Layer5-12, rises to about -1% at Layer13-20, and then increases to roughly 0% at Layer29-32. The red line with square markers, "LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit," begins at approximately 0% for Layer1-4, decreases to about -5% at Layer5-12, rises to around -1% at Layer13-20, and then increases to approximately 0% at Layer29-32. The light blue line with circular markers, "RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit," starts at about -2% for Layer1-4, drops to around -10% at Layer5-12, plunges to approximately -15% at Layer13-20, rises to about -2% at Layer21-28, and then increases to roughly -1% at Layer29-32. The dark blue line with square markers, "RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit," begins at approximately -5% for Layer1-4, decreases to around -10% at Layer5-12, plunges to about -25% at Layer13-20, rises to approximately -5% at Layer21-28, and then increases to roughly -3% at Layer29-32. A dashed gray line at 0% serves as a reference for no change.
